primary_pr.body:
## Summary

Codex Apps needs app-server as the source of truth for chat-started background terminals instead of guessing from local process trees.

This PR adds experimental v2 APIs to list and terminate background terminals for a loaded thread using app-server process ids, so clients can manage background terminals without local PID discovery.

## Changes

- `thread/backgroundTerminals/list` returns paginated background terminal records with `itemId`, app-server `processId`, `command`, `cwd`, nullable `osPid`, nullable `cpuPercent`, and nullable `rssKb`.
- `thread/backgroundTerminals/terminate` terminates one running background terminal by app-server `processId` and returns whether a process was terminated.
- Background terminal list and terminate operations use unified-exec process manager state as their source of truth.
primary_pr.title: Add app-server background terminal process APIs
